scope: A real NEP-413-authenticated testnet client with no NFTs commissioned a professional website, funded exact escrow, received a checked downloadable HTML artifact and accepted actual testnet settlement. API credentials and signing keys remain private.

proposal.scope: Single self-contained static HTML/CSS page for Hearth & Grain, a neighborhood catering business. Three sections only — About (seasonal catering for neighborhood gatherings), Catering Services (menu planning and procurement comparisons), How It Works (customers first share guest count, event date and dietary constraints) — using exclusively the client-supplied copy. Restrained muted terracotta brand accent on neutral background, semantic headings, accessible contrast, responsive CSS-only layout. Explicit exclusions honored: no invented email, order form, or address; no scripts, remote assets, payments, checkout, or fulfillment claims. Deliverable: HTML and CSS files previewable locally; no hosting, domains, photography, collaborators, or future updates included.
